raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner imposed an unnecessary “exact-title” constraint and dismissed the 1927 film “Time to Love” because it lacked the word “The,” despite it being the likely intended film and clearly earlier than Amélie (2001) and Beginners (2010/2011). This misinterpretation prevented recognizing the correct earliest release and led the process toward a wrong comparison.
